configuration_map: No geometric configuration. All objects (m, n, r, s, t, u) are straight lines characterized solely by commensurability relationships. The proof operates entirely through ratios, proportions, and transitivity of commensurability/incommensurability. Rectangles mentioned are areas (rectangle contained by two lines), not spatial figures. No points are placed in any spatial arrangement.
skip_reason: Proposition 10.23 is purely algebraic/proportional. The proof establishes that a line commensurable with a medial line is itself medial by chaining commensurability relations through ratios of squares and rectangles (areas). No geometric configuration claims are made: no point positions, no ray orderings, no angle decompositions, no inside/outside relationships. All reasoning is about length ratios and the definitions of rational and medial lines.
